parks.name: Congaree National Park
parks.blurb: Old-growth floodplain forest; barred owls, turtles, deer and fireflies.

parks.name: Cape Romain National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Barrier islands and marsh; loggerhead turtles, oystercatchers, dolphins and red wolves.

parks.name: Huntington Beach State Park
parks.blurb: Beach and salt marsh; alligators, loggerhead turtles, ospreys and egrets.

parks.name: Hunting Island State Park
parks.blurb: Beach and palmetto forest; loggerhead turtles, dolphins, crabs and deer.

parks.name: Francis Marion National Forest
parks.blurb: Coastal pine forest; red-cockaded woodpeckers, alligators, black bears and deer.

parks.name: Santee Coastal Reserve
parks.blurb: Marsh and cypress; alligators, ospreys, wood storks and egrets.

parks.name: Caw Caw Interpretive Center
parks.blurb: Old rice fields; alligators, wood storks, herons and turtles.

parks.name: Table Rock State Park
parks.blurb: Mountain granite dome; black bears, hawks, salamanders and deer.

parks.name: Edisto Beach State Park
parks.blurb: Beach and maritime forest; sea turtles, dolphins, fiddler crabs and deer.

parks.name: ACE Basin National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Estuary rivers and marsh; alligators, bald eagles, wood storks and dolphins.

parks.name: Harbison State Forest
parks.blurb: Columbia pine forest; deer, owls, turtles and woodpeckers.
